title: Add error handling for network failures in dashboard refresh
description: The auto-refresh function at script.js:286 doesn't handle network failures gracefully. When the API is unreachable, errors accumulate in console. Add retry logic with exponential backoff and display user-friendly error messages.

title: Add generation history with export capability
description: Store test generations in browser localStorage with timestamps. Display history panel below generation form. Allow exporting history as JSON or CSV. Include clear history button.

title: Add dark/light mode toggle
description: Add theme toggle in header. Store preference in localStorage. Create dark mode CSS variables for all colors. Consider using prefers-color-scheme for initial theme detection.

title: Add configurable refresh interval setting
description: Currently hardcoded to 5 seconds at script.js:289. Add UI control to let users set refresh interval (5s, 10s, 30s, 60s) with local storage persistence. Include pause/resume functionality.

title: Update dependencies to latest versions
description: Dependencies in package.json use caret ranges. Pin to specific versions and update to latest: express 4.19+, axios 1.7+, systeminformation 5.23+. Check for breaking changes.

title: Add environment variable configuration for Ollama API URL
description: OLLAMA_API URL is hardcoded at server.js:9. Should support env var OLLAMA_URL with fallback to localhost:11434. Update README.md with configuration examples.

title: Add integration test for network error recovery
description: Test the new exponential backoff and toast notification system. Mock network failures and verify: 1) Backoff delay increases correctly, 2) Toast appears after 3 failures, 3) Success toast shows on recovery. Part of dashboard-3b7 implementation.

title: Add API endpoint tests
description: No tests exist for API endpoints. Add Jest/Supertest for testing /api/health, /api/models, /api/hardware. Mock axios calls to Ollama API. Add npm test script.

title: Fix incorrect disk usage calculation
description: Disk calculation at server.js:106 is incorrect. It doesn't properly get actual used space from diskLayout. Should use fsSize() instead for accurate disk usage per mount point.

title: Add model unload functionality to UI
description: Allow users to unload running models from the dashboard. Add DELETE /api/models/:name endpoint calling Ollama's unload API, plus UI buttons in running models section.

title: Setup complete - Beads is ready for use
description: This test issue verifies that Beads is properly configured and working with OpenCode

title: Add streaming support for model generation
description: Current generation uses stream:false at server.js:79. Implement SSE (Server-Sent Events) for streaming responses to show tokens as they're generated. Improves UX for long responses.
